fields.value: Replication Data for: Blinded by Out-group Hatred: Why Does Radical Party Entry Fail to Boost Its Voters’ Satisfaction with Democracy?

dsDescriptionValue.value: This repository contains all replication files for the analyses reported in "Blinded by Out-group Hatred: Why Does Radical Party Entry Fail to Boost Its Voters' Satisfaction with Democracy?", published in European Political Science Review. It includes three replication scripts, all datasets for Study 2, a preprocessing script for the Study 1 data (which must be downloaded separately from the Sciences Po ELIPSS repository at https://data.sciencespo.fr/dataverse/elipss), and all output figures and tables. The replication files allow full reproduction of all quantitative analyses, figures, and tables reported in the manuscript and supplementary materials. See the README file for full details on the repository structure and instructions for reproducing the results.
